scope: Six actual returned-image art failures: one long-neck correction and five conservative cap-device footprint corrections. Source SHA controls selection. Review index35 maps to original index36 because original24 had a service refusal and no image. Native sheet original24 is that refused source, not the reviewed Kosmas card at review24/original25; Kosmas was separately inspected using original25 and full raw. No false refusal/outcome or retry reset.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actual native source and full raw master inspection: the generated female portrait extends a long tapered yellow neck down the open V, rather than a compact near-round head with curved chin and very short broad transition. Fit the rounded mascot naturally into the original OPEN olive neckline, keeping the actual exposed area and open garment layering without adding a standing collar, tie or cream bib. Retain the original swept/gathered voluminous brown hair, clean-shaven face, restrained smile, frame, note and opaque photograph backing.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Conservative source-faithful art decision after the actual native original and returned source/white/cyan/alpha comparison were inspected: the small source gold cap-front device is indistinct, but the output resolves it into a crisp named wreath/crown/anchor-like emblem. Preserve the exact original visible gold/dark ornament outline, colour, width, height, footprint and natural material texture without resolving it into an unverified named symbol. This does not claim that the tiny original proves a specific symbol absent. Restore the actual front-device shape, including its taller/pointed or broad outline where visible, rather than a generic round insignia. Retain the exact cap colour/top/band/visor and original collar/neckwear state. Do not add new collar insignia where not visibly established. Preserve each source actual hair/facial-hair state, original pose/illumination/crop, frame, note and opaque interior.
